dropped_header.reason: date on or after the cutoff

facts.text: FR's voltage drop grows 6.55 mV per amp of pack current against 2.11 for the other inverters (3.1×), in 1 of 1 snapshots.

If FR carries an equal share of current, its branch resistance is 26.2 mΩ against 8.5 mΩ for the others; over the 21%–29% share the recorded torques allow, 21.7–32.4 mΩ. Its resistance would match the others' only if it carried about 51% of the traction current.
A gain error large enough for this slope (+6.5%) would also show about -4.69 V at rest; FR reads +0.00 V from the others at rest. Weakened, not excluded: an offset could partly cancel it.
Pack current stays within the BMS discharge limit: broken at +0.55 s (151.7 against 150.0)

contact.why: Extra resistance in the branch gives this drop at a normal current share (21%–29%).

conductor.why: Extra resistance in the branch gives this drop at a normal current share (21%–29%).

inverter.why: With a normal branch resistance, FR would carry about 51% of the traction current, above the 21%–29% healthy operation allows. Recorded torque does not show DC current or losses, so this stays open.

fr_sensor.why: A gain error large enough for this slope (+6.5%) would also show about -4.69 V at rest; FR reads +0.00 V from the others at rest. Weakened, not excluded: an offset could partly cancel it.

battery.why: Pack current stays within the BMS discharge limit did not hold in 1 of 1 recorded launches.

observe.what: Pack voltage, current and cell temperatures during a cold launch

hsa_control.why: VCU_Status.HSA_Active was never 1 in the recorded data, so this cannot be checked yet.

observe.what: Record a cold ramp launch with HSA on and off

motor_mech.why: No recorded signal can show this.

observe.what: Lift the wheel and check free rotation and brake drag

recommended.what: With high voltage isolated, and before anyone unplugs or reseats it: four-wire resistance of each FR segment (pack-side connector, cable, fuse, inverter-side connector), and the same on one healthy wheel
recommended.blind_spot: A contact that only opens under load, heat or vibration can read normal at rest; a normal reading weakens a contact fault, it does not exclude it.

then.why: a contact that opens only under load reads normal at rest; measure under load before treating the contact as weakened

known_before.text: FR's voltage drop grows 6.54 mV per amp of pack current against 2.07 for the other inverters (3.2×), in 3 of 3 snapshots.
